title: Gaith
summary: One of the largest donation platforms in the Arab world, redesigned as a mobile app that makes giving simpler, more transparent and accessible.

blocks.title: Goals
bullets: Create a user-friendly and intuitive mobile application.
Let users view detailed information about charities.
Make the app accessible to users with disabilities.

blocks.title: 01 — User Research
blocks.body: Extensive research to understand the target audience, including their needs, preferences and pain points.

blocks.title: 02 — Low Fidelity Wireframes
blocks.body: The research and personas shaped a basic layout and structure for the mobile application.

blocks.title: 03 — Designing a Better Experience
blocks.body: In the high fidelity phase, the client's vision and user needs became pixel-perfect screens, with refined typography, color and layout for a cohesive interface.

blocks.title: 04 — Interactive Prototype
blocks.body: The high fidelity screens became a functional prototype, letting users explore the solutions and give feedback before development.

blocks.title: 05 — Usability Testing
blocks.body: Participants navigated the prototype through real-world scenarios, helping us identify usability issues and make sure the final product felt intuitive and seamless.
